notes: New: set your wallpaper through Kinto. Android blocks apps from reading the wallpaper, but setting one is wide open - so Appearance > Background now has 'Pick a photo & set as wallpaper'. Kinto sets the photo as your phone's wallpaper (Home and Lock screens) and keeps its own copy, so Kinto Home shows that exact image without ever needing to read it back. If you later change your wallpaper outside Kinto, pick the new one there to re-sync. The layer test from 0.7.5 is still in the same card for wallpapers set elsewhere.
